visualReview.method: Inspected all six contact sheets assembled from the actual 1200px JPEG derivatives in storefront position order; this is integration QA of owner-selected previously audited artwork, not a new content/fact audit.

results.note: Correct golden liquid/white label/yellow package. Description, fit, profile and care panels are intact; dance-studio lifestyle trio and product-role frames map correctly.
Correct pale peach liquid/white label/blush package. Home-entry lifestyle trio, exact scent-named panels and all four technical/product roles are present without export cropping.
Correct clear liquid/white label/lavender package. Roller-rink lifestyle trio and face-free detail crops match the selected set; all text panels and closing artwork remain intact.
Correct amber liquid/black label/orange package. Convertible lifestyle trio and scent-named information panels match the selected artwork; every role is visible in the intended order.
Correct blue liquid/black label/blue package. Park/bicycle/picnic artwork and all information and technical-role frames match; no scent swap or cut-off panel.

Store handle rtulle-satin correctly maps to source scent directory rtulle-and-satin and RTULLE & SATIN label. Aqua liquid/turquoise package, pottery-cafe lifestyle trio and all information panels are intact.

visualReview.legibility: Scent names, description/fit copy, profile and care layouts retain their contrast and complete composition. Fine care text is present and benefits from the existing product-image zoom at narrow display sizes. No derivative-specific crop, clipping or visible compression damage was found.

observations.note: All derivatives omit embedded ICC metadata. This is recorded separately from source mapping and visual integration acceptance; standard browser rendering treats untagged RGB web images as sRGB. No source or derivative was changed.
